commit_message: Reduce UI authoring evaluation enum size
pr_title: GameEngine: add Graph and UI authoring service foundation
pr_body:
## Summary

Adds the ADR 0121 shared authoring-service foundation for generic semantic Graph documents and declarative UI documents.

This correction keeps the accepted UI candidate behind Box indirection so the private evaluation enum remains compact under the repository's Clippy -D warnings policy. The service behavior and persisted Graph/UI formats are unchanged.

Editor/CLI/MCP adapter routing and generic layout exposure remain follow-up work.
